page_title: TOR 0-0 CAG | Torino v Cagliari 21/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Francesco Cosso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

90+2' Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

90+1' Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Boris Radunovic has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
87' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) replacing Adam Obert.
87' Here's the change. Antonio Sanabria leaves the pitch and Simone Verdi (Torino) comes on as a substitute.
87' Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
85' A pass by Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
84' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

83' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Cagliari earn a corner.
78' Ivan Ilic (Torino) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
77' Cagliari fail to score from a corner as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) leaps to collect the ball.

77' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cagliari.
75' It's time for a substitution. David Zima (Torino) comes on in place of Ricardo Rodriguez.
73' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
72' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
71' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Nahitan Nandez will be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
68' Here is a change. Samuele Ricci is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Karol Linetty (Torino).
68' Nikola Vlasic will be replaced by Pietro Pellegri (Torino).
65' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

63' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) nicely brought down the pass, but his long-range effort was wild and went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
61' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Zito Luvumbo and he is replaced by Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari).
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) coming on for Gaetano Oristanio.
61' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
59' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is able to continue to play.
59' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
57' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
56' Dangerous play by Ivan Ilic (Torino). Francesco Cosso blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
51' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Samuele Ricci (Torino) takes it short.

51' He should have scored! Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Torino.
49' Samuele Ricci (Torino) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
48' Francesco Cosso interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) comes off for Alessandro Di Pardo.
46' Ivan Juric makes a switch. Nemanja Radonjic is coming on in place of Yann Karamoh (Torino) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Francesco Cosso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.

41' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
39' A dangerous looking corner kick from Samuele Ricci (Torino) is cleared to safety by the defence.
37' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
36' What was Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

32' Yann Karamoh (Torino) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
31' 4:1 – the corner kicks stats.
28' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari). Francesco Cosso saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
26' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
25' Samuele Ricci (Torino) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

23' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
20' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.

19' Perr Schuurs (Torino) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
18' Samuele Ricci (Torino) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

18' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

16' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) produces a good strike that sails to the top right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Cagliari.
15' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
12' Samuele Ricci (Torino) swings in a cross from the corner, but Boris Radunovic reads it well and gathers the ball.
12' Yann Karamoh (Torino) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
10' An attempted cross from Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is cleared.
8' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
7' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
7' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Cagliari are awarded the free kick.
5' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francesco Cosso blows his whistle for a foul.
4' The corner kick from Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

4' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) finds himself some space inside the box and gets on the end of the corner. He lashes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an amazing save to deny him. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
3' Corner kick. Torino will have an opportunity.

3' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
2' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Francesco Cosso was nominated as the referee for this game.
